name: SET
syntax: SET key value [EX seconds|PX milliseconds|EXAT timestamp|PXAT milliseconds-timestamp|KEEPTTL] [NX|XX] [GET] [TAGS tag ...]

name: BLMOVE
syntax: BLMOVE source destination LEFT|RIGHT LEFT|RIGHT timeout

name: LPOS
syntax: LPOS key element [RANK rank] [COUNT num-matches] [MAXLEN len]

name: ZRANGE
syntax: ZRANGE key start stop [WITHSCORES] [BYSCORE|BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZRANGEBYSCORE
syntax: ZRANGEBYSCORE key min max [WITHSCORES] [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZREVRANGEBYSCORE
syntax: ZREVRANGEBYSCORE key max min [WITHSCORES] [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZRANGEBYLEX
syntax: ZRANGEBYLEX key min max [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZREVRANGEBYLEX
syntax: ZREVRANGEBYLEX key max min [LIMIT offset count]

name: ZINTERSTORE
syntax: ZINTERSTORE destination numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE SUM|MIN|MAX]

name: ZUNIONSTORE
syntax: ZUNIONSTORE destination numkeys key [key ...] [WEIGHTS weight [weight ...]] [AGGREGATE SUM|MIN|MAX]

name: BITFIELD
syntax: BITFIELD key [GET type offset] [SET type offset value] [INCRBY type offset increment] [OVERFLOW WRAP|SAT|FAIL]

name: GEOADD
syntax: GEOADD key [NX|XX] [CH] longitude latitude member [longitude latitude member ...]

name: GEORADIUS
syntax: GEORADIUS key longitude latitude radius M|KM|FT|MI [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC|DESC] [STORE key] [STOREDIST key]

name: GEORADIUSBYMEMBER
syntax: GEORADIUSBYMEMBER key member radius M|KM|FT|MI [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH] [COUNT count [ANY]] [ASC|DESC] [STORE key] [STOREDIST key]

name: GEOSEARCH
syntax: GEOSEARCH key [FROMMEMBER m] [FROMLONLAT lon lat] [BYRADIUS rad M|KM|FT|MI] [BYBOX w h M|KM|FT|MI] [ASC|DESC] [COUNT count [ANY]] [WITHCOORD] [WITHDIST] [WITHHASH]

name: GEOSEARCHSTORE
syntax: GEOSEARCHSTORE destination source [FROMMEMBER m] [FROMLONLAT lon lat] [BYRADIUS rad M|KM|FT|MI] [BYBOX w h M|KM|FT|MI] [ASC|DESC] [COUNT count [ANY]] [STOREDIST]

name: XADD
syntax: XADD key [NOMKSTREAM] [MAXLEN|MINID [=|~] threshold [LIMIT count]] id field value [field value ...]

name: XREAD
syntax: XREAD [COUNT count] [BLOCK milliseconds] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]

name: XREADGROUP
syntax: XREADGROUP GROUP group consumer [COUNT count] [BLOCK milliseconds] [NOACK] STREAMS key [key ...] id [id ...]

name: XCLAIM
syntax: XCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time id [id ...] [IDLE ms] [TIME ms-unix-time] [RETRYCOUNT count] [FORCE] [JUSTID]

name: XAUTOCLAIM
syntax: XAUTOCLAIM key group consumer min-idle-time start [COUNT count] [JUSTID]

name: XPENDING
syntax: XPENDING key group [[IDLE min-idle-time] start end count [consumer]]

name: RESTORE
syntax: RESTORE key ttl serialized-value [REPLACE] [ABSTTL] [IDLETIME seconds] [FREQ frequency]

name: TS.CREATE
syntax: TS.CREATE key [RETENTION retentionTime] [ENCODING encoding] [CHUNK_SIZE size] [DUPLICATE_POLICY policy] [LABELS label value [label value ...]]

name: TS.ALTER
syntax: TS.ALTER key [RETENTION retentionTime] [CHUNK_SIZE size] [DUPLICATE_POLICY policy] [LABELS label value [label value ...]]

name: TS.ADD
syntax: TS.ADD key timestamp value [RETENTION retentionTime] [ENCODING encoding] [CHUNK_SIZE size] [ON_DUPLICATE policy] [LABELS label value [label value ...]]

name: TS.MADD
syntax: TS.MADD key timestamp value [key timestamp value ...]

name: TS.CREATERULE
syntax: TS.CREATERULE sourceKey destKey AGGREGATION aggregationType timeBucket

name: TS.RANGE
syntax: TS.RANGE key fromTimestamp toTimestamp [COUNT count] [AGGREGATION aggregationType timeBucket [BUCKETTIMESTAMP bt] [EMPTY]]

name: TS.REVRANGE
syntax: TS.REVRANGE key fromTimestamp toTimestamp [COUNT count] [AGGREGATION aggregationType timeBucket [BUCKETTIMESTAMP bt] [EMPTY]]

name: TS.MRANGE
syntax: TS.MRANGE fromTimestamp toTimestamp [COUNT count] [AGGREGATION aggregationType timeBucket [BUCKETTIMESTAMP bt] [EMPTY]] [WITHLABELS] [SELECTED_LABELS label [label ...]] [FILTER filter [filter ...]] [GROUPBY label REDUCE reducer]

name: TS.MREVRANGE
syntax: TS.MREVRANGE fromTimestamp toTimestamp [COUNT count] [AGGREGATION aggregationType timeBucket [BUCKETTIMESTAMP bt] [EMPTY]] [WITHLABELS] [SELECTED_LABELS label [label ...]] [FILTER filter [filter ...]] [GROUPBY label REDUCE reducer]

name: FT.CREATE
syntax: FT.CREATE index [ON HASH|JSON] [PREFIX count prefix [prefix ...]] [SCHEMA field type [field type ...]]

name: FT.ADD
syntax: FT.ADD index docId score [NOSAVE] [REPLACE] [PARTIAL] [LANGUAGE lang] [PAYLOAD payload] [FIELDS field value [field value ...]]

name: FT.SEARCH
syntax: FT.SEARCH index query [NOCONTENT] [VERBATIM] [NOSTOPWORDS] [WITHSCORES] [WITHPAYLOADS] [WITHSORTKEYS] [FILTER numericField min max [FILTER numericField min max ...]] [GEOFILTER geoField lon lat radius M|KM|MI|FT] [INKEYS count key [key ...]] [INFIELDS count field [field ...]] [RETURN count field [field ...]] [SUMMARIZE [FIELDS count field [field ...]] [FRAGS num] [LEN fragsize] [SEPARATOR separator]] [HIGHLIGHT [FIELDS count field [field ...]] [TAGS open close]] [SLOP slop] [TIMEOUT timeout] [LIMIT offset num]

name: FT.AGGREGATE
syntax: FT.AGGREGATE index query [VERBATIM] [LOAD count field [field ...]] [GROUPBY nargs property [property ...] [REDUCE func nargs arg [arg ...] [AS name]] [REDUCE ...]] [SORTBY nargs [property [ASC|DESC] [property [ASC|DESC] ...]] [MAX num] [AS name]] [APPLY expr AS name] [FILTER expr] [LIMIT offset num] [QUERY_EXECUTION_TIME] [TIMEOUT timeout]

name: FT.SPELLCHECK
syntax: FT.SPELLCHECK index query [DISTANCE dist] [TERMS {INCLUDE | EXCLUDE} dict [TERMS {INCLUDE | EXCLUDE} dict ...]] [FULLSCOREINFO] [TIMEOUT timeout]

name: FT.ALTER
syntax: FT.ALTER index SCHEMA ADD field type [field type ...]

name: GRAPH.CONSTRAINT
syntax: GRAPH.CONSTRAINT CREATE graphName constraintType nodeLabel|relType properties [entityType entityType]

name: GRAPH.CONSTRAINT
syntax: GRAPH.CONSTRAINT DROP graphName constraintType nodeLabel|relType properties [entityType entityType]

name: BF.INSERT
syntax: BF.INSERT key [CAPACITY capacity] [ERROR error] [EXPANSION expansion] [NOCREATE] [NONSCALING] ITEMS item [item ...]

name: CF.RESERVE
syntax: CF.RESERVE key capacity [BUCKETSIZE bucketsize] [MAXITERATIONS maxiterations] [EXPANSION expansion]

name: CIRCUITX.CREATE
syntax: CIRCUITX.CREATE name [FAILURE_THRESHOLD threshold] [SUCCESS_THRESHOLD threshold] [TIMEOUT timeout] [HALF_OPEN_MAX max]

name: RETRY.CREATE
syntax: RETRY.CREATE name maxAttempts [BACKOFF_TYPE type] [INITIAL_DELAY delay] [MAX_DELAY delay]

name: MODEL.CREATE
syntax: MODEL.CREATE name type [PARAMS param value [param value ...]]

name: SET
syntax: SET key value [EX seconds] [PX milliseconds] [NX|XX] [TAGS tag [tag ...]]

name: SELECT
syntax: SELECT index                      # Select database (alias for namespace)

name: GEO.DISTANCE
syntax: GEO.DISTANCE lat1 lon1 lat2 lon2 [UNIT unit]
